basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer | AI × CI/CD | Containers, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions
basics.summary: Senior engineer building at the intersection of AI and CI/CD in production. At Beekeeper I shipped an LLM pipeline on GitHub Actions in 6 weeks that replaced a $337K annual vendor and now translates 12K+ assets. At LumApps I run production multi-agent systems on GCP with tools exposed over MCP, evals, and cost telemetry. 13+ years shipping to 10M+ users on Docker, Kubernetes, and modern CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions). Comfortable owning features end to end, working directly with Product, and picking up new stacks quickly (Go included).

work.name: LumApps
highlights: Built production multi-agent workflows (Python, LangGraph, Google ADK on GCP Vertex AI) with tools exposed over MCP and state streamed to the UI. Directly parallel to the agent skills / agentic foundation Chainguard is extending into customer-facing products.

Own the AI platform end to end: architecture, eval pipelines, LangSmith tracing across model, orchestration, and infra layers, cost-per-request telemetry, and on-call. Same discipline the AI × CI/CD role needs to ship reliably.
Report directly to C-level on outcomes. 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, $1M forecast in quarterly revenue on the outbound product built on this platform.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
highlights: Shipped an LLM pipeline on GitHub Actions + OpenAI APIs in 6 weeks that replaced a $337K annual vendor. 12K+ assets translated on every merge; hardened workflow that product engineers extend without breaking.

Ran production on Docker + Kubernetes (AWS EKS) for 10M+ users. Owned Jenkins → GitHub Actions migration, containerized services, and the CI/CD pipeline for critical release paths. Enforced comprehensive unit, integration, and E2E test coverage.
Architected Employee Referral System end to end (Java, PostgreSQL, Elastic Search on Kubernetes). Became the platform's top revenue channel: $1.5M+ revenue, $500K ARR at 99.99% SLA.
Ran observability and global on-call (Grafana, Datadog, Logz.io, Langfuse for LLM traces). Diagnosed and triaged incidents across container, service, and infra layers.

work.name: Dronistics
highlights: Founding engineer for an EPFL spin-off. Shipped the full autonomous drone delivery platform (Vue/Java/PostgreSQL, containerized on Docker) that powered 500+ real-world deliveries.
Built AWS infrastructure and CI/CD pipeline from scratch (Docker, Terraform for IaC). Enterprise-grade reliability that enabled a Unilever partnership and a CES showcase.

_jobApplication.jobDescription: Senior Software Engineer, AI CICD at Chainguard (secure software supply chain, hardened OSS builds). Extend Chainguard's agentic AI foundation into customer-facing products. Must: 5+ years SWE, containers/artifact registries/Docker/Kubernetes ecosystem, CI/CD systems, Go (or ramp fast), AI tooling. Bonus: strong Product collaboration, autonomy.

Strong overlap on containers/K8s/CI-CD (Beekeeper), GitHub Actions + AI pipelines (Beekeeper LLM pipeline), MCP + agents + agent-skills-adjacent work (LumApps), IaC + Docker (Dronistics).
